TABLE.NAME: tool_quizbulkedit_config
TABLE.COMMENT: Named settings configurations: per course (courseid > 0) or site-wide admin presets (courseid = 0)

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: Course the configuration belongs to; 0 for an admin preset

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The configuration's name, unique within the course (or among the presets)

FIELD.NAME: data
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON snapshot of the settings form fields (and, for a course, the ticked quizzes)

INDEX.NAME: coursename
INDEX.COMMENT: One configuration per name in a course or among the presets
